title: Strip Compose Coda Playwright Mcp Entries From Agent Configs
description: Compose engine MCP server fails to start because the top-level .mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json, .codex/config.toml and .kiro/settings/mcp.json only register the repo server on HEAD. Kinan's earlier "Fix Mcp Tooling For All Agents" branch added compose/coda/playwright-test entries but never merged into HEAD. Restore the four-server config across all agent config files so Claude Code, VS Code, Codex and Kiro all start the compose engine MCP via `uv --directory compose/engine run main.py --mcp-stdio`. Verify the engine actually responds to initialize and tools/list over stdio.
summary: Per dev direction ("Dont add additional mcp servers such as playwright, compose and coda"), aligned all agent MCP configs to only register the `repo` server. Removed stale `compose`, `coda`, `playwright-test` entries from .cursor/mcp.json and .windsurf/mcp.json; pruned `mcpServers.playwright-test|compose|coda` and the matching `@compose`/`@coda`/`@playwright-test` allowedTools from .kiro/agents/compose.json. .mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json, .codex/config.toml, .kiro/settings/mcp.json already contained only `repo`. Confirmed the compose engine still launches fine via `uv --directory compose/engine run main.py --mcp-stdio` and responds to MCP initialize/tools-list (kept for npm `mcp:inspector`), but is no longer registered as a standalone MCP server in any agent config.
